youtube.title: Good Morning Bible Verse | Zephaniah 3:17 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. You might need to hear this one today.

"The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing." Zephaniah 3:17 (KJV)

God rejoices over you with singing. Think about that on the drive in.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
